about.firstParagraph: I'm Barialai Nawabi. Through Inkphase, I create identities, video and motion for brands with something to say. I bring more than five years of experience and have delivered 174+ projects.
about.secondParagraph: I've held senior roles in graphic design, creative design, video editing and AI creative production. I use practical AI tools to explore ideas, then shape the work through design judgment. My experience spans trading and crypto, real estate, education, hospitality and digital media. I hold a Master of Computer Applications from Goa University and collaborate with specialists when a project needs extra expertise.
